PARK HOURS
The park is open daily from 7 a.m. to 10
p.m. for use from May 1 to October 31.
CAMPGROUND QUIET HOURS
Quiet hours are between 10 p.m. – 7 a.m.
FIREWOOD
Firewood is available for purchase at the
park office. Collecting firewood in the park
is prohibited. To help prevent the spread of
invasive species, we ask that visitors do not
bring or use out-of-state firewood.
PETS ON LEASHES
Pets are welcome but must stay on a leash
while in the state park and on all trails.
EMERGENCY INFO
In an emergency dial 911. Find fire danger
ratings and restrictions at ndresponse.gov.
